# Security Rules
- Follow space law, you're a police officer. - Don't purposefully make people have a miserable time. - Stay identifiable as a police officer. - Escalate reasonably, dont magdump everyone who breaks the law. - Declare your intention before taking action against players unless they pose a very obvious threat (wearing blood-red armor / brandishing a dangerous weapons) - You [bold]may not[/bold] use contraband unless it is an absolute emergency, examples below. - You are a police officer in a dystopian corporation, you can act like that to an extent. - If you piss players off enough they are going to group up and kick your ass so keep that in mind.
## Examples:
- If a traitor trying to kill you drops their weapon, you may use it. - You may use contraband against a station ending threat like nukies or an ascended heretic. - Avoid using contraband in most situations, it shows that both you and nanotrasen are weak.
